items.title: PathoEvo: an interactive single-cell database for exploring disease progression and pathological evolution
items.title_zh: PathoEvo：一个用于探索疾病进展和病理演化的交互式单细胞数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 疾病进展由组织微环境、细胞组成、细胞状态和转录程序的协调变化驱动。单细胞和单核RNA测序使这些变化能够在细胞分辨率下进行研究。然而，公共疾病相关数据集通常组织在单个研究内，并使用异质的临床、病理或分子分期系统进行注释，限制了跨疾病阶段和数据集之间的比较。在此，我们介绍PathoEvo（https://biomedlab-ai.com/pathoevo/），一个以疾病进展为中心的疾病相关单细胞和单核转录组数据库。PathoEvo整合了来自981个样本和59个数据集的7,452,971个细胞或细胞核，覆盖18种疾病和27个进展框架。通过人工策展、统一处理、元数据协调、细胞类型注释和阶段映射，PathoEvo将异质数据集组织成围绕疾病进展的标准化资源。其数据和分析功能跨越三个互补层次，允许用户检查与疾病阶段和细胞状态相关的细胞组成变化，表征跨疾病进展的样本级分子变异，并研究相关细胞群体和样

extra.description: Abstract Disease progression is driven by coordinated changes in tissue microenvironments, cellular composition, cell states, and transcriptional programmes. Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing enable these changes to be studied at cellular resolution. However, public disease-associated datasets are often organized within individual studies and annotated using heterogeneous clinical, pathological, or molecular staging systems, limiting comparison across disease stages and datasets. Here, we present PathoEvo (https://biomedlab-ai.com/pathoevo/), a disease-associated single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic database centred on disease progression. PathoEvo integrates 7 452 971 cells or nuclei from 981 samples and 59 datasets, covering 18 diseases and 27 progression frameworks. Through manual curation, unified processing, metadata harmonization, cell-type annotation, and stage mapping, PathoEvo organizes heterogeneous datasets into standardized resources organized around disease progression. Its data and analytical functions span three complementary levels, allowing users to examine changes in cellular composition associated with disease stage and cell states, characterize sample-level molecular variation across disease progression, and investigate gene expression dynamics across relevant cell populations and samples. Structured search and browsing further facilitate dataset discovery and navigation of stage-resolved information across diseases and staging systems. PathoEvo provides an integrative resource for investigating pathological evolution and comparing cellular and molecular patterns of disease progression across datasets at single-cell resolution.

items.title: STRAND: a comprehensive subcellular-resolved spatial transcriptome RNA architecture and navigation database
items.title_zh: STRAND：一个全面的亚细胞分辨率空间转录组RNA架构与导航数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要：亚细胞RNA定位是控制细胞极化、局部翻译和功能区室化的关键调控层。高分辨率空间转录组学的最新进展为在单分子分辨率下解析这些细胞内架构提供了前所未有的机会。然而，相关数据集分散于各研究和存储库中，处理程序和标准差异很大，严重限制了跨研究复用。为弥合这一差距，我们推出STRAND（亚细胞分辨率空间转录组RNA架构与导航数据库），一个用于自动采集、质量控制和解读亚细胞空间转录组学数据的精选数据资源与分析平台。通过智能体辅助的策展流程，STRAND已从六大平台汇编了35个亚细胞分辨率数据集，覆盖人类和小鼠的17种组织类型，总计约49亿个转录本坐标。基于这一标准化数据资源，STRAND提供了涵盖细胞分割评估、细胞类型注释、RNA定位/共定位模式注释和亚细胞区室推断的分析工作流。两个案例研究表明，STRAND成功识别了培养细胞系中已确立的RNA定位模式，并检测了心肌细胞中药物诱导的RNA重定位。

extra.description: Abstract Subcellular RNA localization serves as a critical regulatory layer governing cellular polarization, local translation, and functional compartmentalization. Recent advances in high-resolution spatial transcriptomics have provided unprecedented opportunities to resolve these intracellular architectures at single-molecule resolution. However, relevant datasets are dispersed across studies and repositories, vary substantially in processing procedures and standards, severely limiting their cross-study reuse. To bridge this gap, we present STRAND (Subcellular-Resolved Spatial Transcriptome RNA Architecture and Navigation Database), a curated data resource and analysis platform for the automated harvesting, quality control, and interpretation of subcellular spatial transcriptomics data. Through an agent-assisted curation pipeline, STRAND has assembled 35 subcellular-resolution datasets from six major platforms, covering 17 tissue types in human and mouse and totalling ∼4.9 billion transcript coordinates. Building upon this standardized data resource, STRAND provides an analytical workflow spanning cell segmentation evaluation, cell-type annotation, RNA localization/colocalization pattern annotation, and subcellular compartment inference. Two case studies demonstrate that STRAND successfully identifies established RNA localization patterns in cultured cell lines and detects drug-induced RNA relocalization in cardiomyocytes. STRAND is openly available at https://strand.phasep.pro.

items.title: Cd47 deficiency in mouse brain under excitotoxic stress
items.title_zh: 兴奋性毒性应激下小鼠大脑中Cd47的缺失
items.summary_zh: CD47是一种具有明确免疫和神经发育作用的跨膜蛋白，最近被鉴定为人类、非人灵长类和小鼠中丰富的突触前蛋白。为研究Cd47如何影响神经元应激和损伤，我们对暴露于惊厥剂量（KA25；25 mg/kg）或亚惊厥剂量（KA3；3 mg/kg）海人藻酸（KA）的野生型（WT）和Cd47敲除（KO）小鼠海马进行了单核RNA测序。将细胞类型注释与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）相结合，揭示了不同的神经元和胶质基因模块，其共表达结构因基因型和KA暴露而异。值得注意的是，某些模块仅在Cd47缺陷细胞中显示出与KA相关的共表达结构变化。这些模块的富集分析突出了翻译、生物能量和突触基因集。使用Wasserstein距离比较全转录组分布表明，在所有十五个成对比较中，载体处理的KO细胞最接近暴露于KA3的WT细胞。这些发现表明，Cd47缺失使海马转录组向类似轻度兴奋性毒性应激的状态转变，暗示Cd47是神经元应激

extra.description: CD47, a transmembrane protein with well-established immune and neurodevelopmental roles, was recently identified as an abundant presynaptic protein in humans, non-human primates, and mice. To investigate how Cd47 influences neuronal stress and injury, we performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of hippocampi from wild-type (WT) and Cd47 knockout (KO) mice exposed to kainic acid (KA) at convulsive (KA25; 25 mg/kg) or subconvulsive (KA3; 3 mg/kg) doses. Integrating cell-type annotations with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed distinct neuronal and glial gene modules whose co-expression structure differed by genotype and by KA exposure. Notably, certain modules showed KA-associated changes in co-expression structure only in Cd47 -deficient cells. Enrichment analyses of these modules highlighted translational, bioenergetic, and synaptic gene sets. Comparing transcriptome-wide distributions using Wasserstein distance demonstrated that vehicle-treated KO cells most closely resembled WT cells exposed to KA3, of all fifteen pairwise comparisons. These findings suggest that Cd47 loss shifts the hippocampal transcriptome toward a state resembling mild excitotoxic stress, implicating Cd47 as a candidate regulator of neuronal stress adaptation and providing a hypothesis for testing that role.

items.title: OSCAR: an omics atlas of paired single-cell ATAC-seq and RNA-seq for decoding cell-specific gene regulation
items.title_zh: OSCAR：一个配对单细胞ATAC-seq和RNA-seq的组学图谱，用于解码细胞特异性基因调控
items.summary_zh: 摘要 配对的单细胞染色质可及性和转录组谱为剖析多种生物过程和人类疾病背后的细胞特异性调控程序提供了强大框架。配对单细胞转座酶可及染色质测序（scATAC-seq）和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据的快速积累，迫切需要全面整合这些数据以在单细胞分辨率下阐明调控景观。为满足这一需求，我们开发了OSCAR（配对单细胞ATAC和RNA-seq组学图谱，https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/），以策展大规模配对scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq数据，并提供全面的调控注释和分析。当前版本的OSCAR收录了来自30种组织类型的1136个样本的7,749,898个人类细胞。重要的是，OSCAR整合了配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq谱以进行联合细胞聚类和峰到基因连锁识别，并为标记峰和标记基因的调控元件提供详细的（表观）遗传注释，包括超级增强子、增强子、增强子

extra.description: Abstract Paired single-cell chromatin accessibility and transcriptome profiles provide a powerful framework for dissecting cell-specific regulatory programs underlying diverse biological processes and human diseases. The rapid accumulation of paired single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data has led to an urgent need to comprehensively integrate these data to illustrate the regulatory landscape at single-cell resolution. To address this need, we developed OSCAR (an Omics atlas of paired Single-Cell ATAC and RNA-seq, https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/) to curate large-scale paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq data and to provide comprehensive regulatory annotations and analyses. The current version of OSCAR catalogs 7749 898 human cells from 1136 samples across 30 tissue types. Importantly, OSCAR integrates paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq profiles for joint cell clustering and peak-to-gene linkage identification, and provides detailed (epi)genetic annotations for marker peaks and regulatory elements of marker genes, including super-enhancers, enhancers, enhancer RNAs (eRNAs), common and risk single nucleotide polymorphisms, expression quantitative trait loci, transcription factor binding sites, transcription factor/transcription co-factor binding peaks, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)/Cas9 target sites, DNase I hypersensitivity sites, chromatin accessibility regions, DNA methylation sites, chromatin interaction regions, and topologically associating domains. Furthermore, OSCAR provides three online analysis tools, including cell type enrichment analysis, sequence-based peak regulatory analysis, and peak-to-gene linkage analysis. Hence, OSCAR is a useful platform to query, browse, analyze, and visualize cell-specific regulatory programs across diverse human tissues and diseases.

items.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
items.title_zh: 一个通过分层适应策略进行多类型染色质相互作用预测的可扩展深度学习框架
items.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

items.title: CAnDi: a global catalogue of anaerobic digestion microbiomes
items.title_zh: CAnDi：全球厌氧消化微生物组目录
items.summary_zh: 摘要 产甲烷环境孕育着复杂的原核生物群落，驱动有机物厌氧转化为甲烷和二氧化碳。除了对全球碳循环至关重要外，这些过程已被引导为生物反应器中用于能源生产的强大生物技术。解码这些群落的功能和分类景观需要全面调查，包括噬菌体和质粒，然而这些在当前数据库中仍然严重代表性不足。在此，我们介绍微生物厌氧消化目录（CAnDi），一个包含从全球1256个生物反应器采集的宏基因组样本中恢复的11,149个物种的36,480个原核基因组的数据库。重建的宏基因组还编码了约190万个病毒序列和超过13万个质粒序列。同一性聚类揭示了约53.6万个候选病毒物种，其中85%相对于现有数据库是新的，以及超过15,000个独特质粒。病毒和质粒蛋白簇从头生成，分别总计1,721,182和123,813个不同蛋白家族。总之，这些资源大幅推进了先前表征厌氧消化微生物组的系统方法，为研究病毒组和质粒组在产甲烷生态系统中的生态和进化作

extra.description: Abstract Methanogenic environments harbour complex prokaryotic consortia that drive the anaerobic conversion of organic matter into methane and carbon dioxide. Beyond being key to the global carbon cycle, such processes have been steered into powerful biotechnologies for energy production in bioreactors. Decoding the functional and taxonomic landscape of these communities requires comprehensive surveys, including bacteriophages and plasmids, which, however, remain vastly underrepresented in current databases. Here, we present the microbial Catalogue of Anaerobic Digestion (CAnDi), a database comprising 36 480 prokaryotic genomes spanning 11 149 species recovered from 1256 metagenomic samples collected across bioreactors worldwide. The reconstructed metagenomes also encode ∼1.9 million viral and over 130 000 plasmid sequences. Identity clustering revealed ∼536 000 candidate viral species, of which 85% are novel relative to existing databases, as well as over 15 000 unique plasmids. Clusters of viral and plasmid proteins were generated de novo, totalling 1 721 182 and 123 813 distinct protein families, respectively. Together, these resources substantially advance previous systematic approaches to characterize anaerobic digestion microbiomes, providing an expanded foundation for investigating the ecological and evolutionary roles of the virome and plasmidome in methane-producing ecosystems. CAnDi is accessible via https://www.candi-db.org/.

items.title: Multi-omics survival prediction under modality incompleteness via dynamic modality graphs and product-of-experts fusion.
items.title_zh: 通过动态模态图和专家乘积融合实现模态不完整下的多组学生存预测。
items.summary_zh: 多组学数据整合为癌症生存预测提供了丰富的互补信息，但模态不完整在真实医疗数据中普遍存在，削弱了现有模型的稳定性和适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DMG-PoE，一个用于多组学生存预测的稳健学习框架。该框架引入动态模态图（DMG），在模态节点间传播互补信息以补偿缺失输入，并结合不确定性感知的专家乘积（PoE）融合机制，按各模态的估计精度自适应加权，以及一致性约束训练策略，在不同模态子集下稳定预测。在SurvBoard基准上对10种TCGA癌症类型和七种组学模态的系统评估表明，DMG-PoE在标准设置（完整模态训练/测试）和缺失增强设置（训练额外包含真实不完整样本和非临床模态丢弃，仅完整测试）下均取得最高平均C-index；受控的逐模态掩蔽实验在22/24个癌症-模态组合中验证了有效的测试时恢复，仅在七种模态中两种可用时的跨队列迁移进一步证实了严重输入限制下的泛化能力。

extra.description: Multi-omics data integration provides rich complementary information for cancer survival prediction, yet modality incompleteness is pervasive in real-world medical data and undermines the stability and applicability of existing models. To address this challenge, we propose DMG-PoE, a robust learning framework for multi-omics survival prediction. The framework introduces a dynamic modality graph (DMG) that propagates complementary information across modality nodes to compensate for missing inputs, combined with an uncertainty-aware product-of-experts (PoE) fusion mechanism that adaptively weights each modality by its estimated precision, and a consistency-constrained training strategy that stabilizes predictions across varying modality subsets. Systematic evaluation on the SurvBoard benchmark across 10 TCGA cancer types and seven omics modalities demonstrates that DMG-PoE achieves the highest average C-index under both the standard setting (complete-modality training/testing) and the missing-augmented setting (training additionally includes real incomplete samples and nonclinical modality dropout, with complete-only testing); controlled per-modality masking experiments validate effective test-time recovery in 22/24 cancer-modality combinations, and cross-cohort transfer with only two of seven modalities available further confirms generalization under severe input restriction.

items.title: The recount3 Python package for programmatic access to uniformly processed RNA-seq data
items.title_zh: 用于程序化访问统一处理RNA-seq数据的recount3 Python包
items.summary_zh: 摘要：recount3在线资源提供了来自序列读取档案等主要测序存储库的数万个经统一处理的人类和小鼠RNA-seq样本。虽然这些数据集的访问传统上以R/Bioconductor生态系统为中心，但Python在生物信息学和机器学习中的日益突出地位要求为Python用户提供原生、高效的工具。因此，我们推出recount3 Python包，提供稳健的应用程序编程接口（API）和命令行界面（CLI），用于发现、下载和物化recount3资源。该软件协调统一资源定位符（URL）解析、持久磁盘缓存以及自动将数据解析为可分析的数据结构，包括Pandas DataFrame和BiocPy RangedSummarizedExperiment对象。recount3 Python包大幅降低了在基于Python的计算流程中大规模利用RNA-seq数据的门槛，弥合了海量公共转录组数据与现代机器学习生态系统之间的差距

extra.description: Abstract The recount3 online resource provides tens of thousands of uniformly processed RNA-seq samples across human and mouse from major sequencing repositories like the Sequence Read Archive. While access to these datasets has traditionally been centered in the R/Bioconductor ecosystem, the growing prominence of Python in bioinformatics and machine learning necessitates native, efficient tooling for Python users. Therefore, we present the recount3 Python package with robust application programming interface (API) and command-line interface (CLI) for discovering, downloading, and materializing recount3 resources. The software orchestrates uniform resource locator (URL) resolution, persistent on-disk caching, and the automatic parsing of data into analysis-ready data structures, including Pandas DataFrames and BiocPy RangedSummarizedExperiment objects. The recount3 Python package drastically lowers the barrier to entry for large-scale utilization of RNA-seq data in Python-based computational pipelines, bridging the gap between massive public transcriptomic data and modern machine learning ecosystems.

items.title: IsoPrism predicts isoform usage from short-read transcriptomes through structure-guided competitive allocation.
items.title_zh: IsoPrism通过结构引导的竞争性分配从短读转录组预测异构体使用。
items.summary_zh: 短读（SR）单细胞和空间转录组学可表征基因表达，但对基因内异构体使用的分辨率有限。在此我们提出IsoPrism，一个结构引导的竞争性分配框架，从基因水平表达预测异构体比例。IsoPrism将个体表达和局部表达上下文与转录本结构注释相结合，使用共享迭代更新保持非负、基因归一化的比例。来自个体长读（LR）计数和组水平异构体使用的联合监督使得在无匹配LR测量的样本中也能预测。在源自三个配对转录组资源的五种迁移场景中，IsoPrism在八种评估方法中取得最高的平均主导异构体准确度、组成相似性和簇水平分配相关性。消融分析支持结构查询、表达上下文、迭代分配和双分辨率监督的互补贡献。应用于发育中的小鼠皮层图谱，IsoPrism识别了阶段和细胞类型相关的异构体使用模式，包括两个Pkm转录本预测相对使用的变化。IsoPrism通过从配对LR参考转移信息，实现了SR转录组的异构体使用分析，扩展了现有单细胞和空

extra.description: Short-read (SR) single-cell and spatial transcriptomics characterize gene expression but provide limited resolution of within-gene isoform usage. Here we present IsoPrism, a structure-guided competitive allocation framework that predicts isoform proportions from gene-level expression. IsoPrism combines individual expression and local expression context with transcript structural annotations, using shared iterative updates to preserve non-negative, gene-normalized proportions. Joint supervision from individual long-read (LR) counts and group-level isoform usage enables prediction in samples without matched LR measurements. Across five transfer scenarios derived from three paired transcriptomic resources, IsoPrism achieved the highest mean dominant isoform accuracy, compositional similarity, and cluster-level allocation correlation among eight evaluated methods. Ablation analyses supported complementary contributions from structural queries, expression context, iterative allocation, and dual-resolution supervision. Applied to a developing mouse cortex atlas, IsoPrism identified stage- and cell-type-associated isoform-usage patterns, including variation in the predicted relative usage of two Pkm transcripts. IsoPrism enables isoform-usage analysis of SR transcriptomes by transferring information from paired LR references, extending the analytical value of existing single-cell and spatial gene-expression atlases.

items.title: ADInteractome: discovering Alzheimer's disease-associated gene interactions from single-nucleus RNA-seq data through neural interaction states.
items.title_zh: ADInteractome：通过神经交互状态从单核RNA-seq数据发现阿尔茨海默病相关基因相互作用。
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种以淀粉样β斑块和tau缠结为特征的常见神经退行性疾病，但其分子机制仍不明确。单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）的进展为AD相关大脑的细胞异质性提供了深刻见解。在本研究中，我们推出ADInteractome，一个可解释的人工智能框架，旨在直接从基于脑细胞snRNA-seq数据训练的神经网络内部状态中发现与AD相关的基因相互作用。该方法基于这样的直觉：如果神经网络能根据snRNA-seq数据准确分类来自AD和非AD供体的细胞，那么其内部交互状态——反映基因表达数据中的交互模式——对于识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用具有信息价值。应用于西雅图阿尔茨海默病脑细胞图谱的大规模snRNA-seq数据集，ADInteractome揭示了细胞类型特异性和AD相关的基因回路，并得到现有文献支持。我们的虚拟敲除和敲入实验进一步支持了这些结果，这是一种通过数据驱动方法探究发现的新概念

extra.description: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a prevalent neurodegenerative disorder characterized by amyloid $\beta $ plaques and tau tangles, yet its molecular mechanisms remain elusive. Advances in single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) have provided profound insights into the cellular heterogeneity of AD-associated brains. In this study, we introduce ADInteractome, an interpretable artificial intelligence framework designed to discover gene interactions associated with AD directly from the internal state of neural networks trained on the snRNA-seq data of brain cells. The method is based on the intuition that if a neural network can accurately classify cells from AD and non-AD donors based on their snRNA-seq data, then its internal interaction states, reflecting interaction patterns within the gene expression data, are informative for identifying biologically meaningful gene interactions. Applied to a large-scale snRNA-seq dataset from the Seattle Alzheimer's Disease Brain Cell Atlas, ADInteractome reveals cell-type-specific and AD-associated gene circuits supported by existing literature. The results were further supported by our virtual knock-out and knock-in experiments, a novel concept to probe our findings through a data-driven approach. Compared with traditional co-expression network methods, it achieves stronger enrichment for known AD-associated gene interactions and uncovers novel interaction patterns. These findings highlight the potential of interpretable AI approaches for elucidating complex molecular interactions in neurodegenerative disease.

items.title: CircaVal: a gene-centric multi-omics platform for exploring circadian regulatory features.
items.title_zh: CircaVal：一个以基因为中心的多组学平台，用于探索昼夜节律调控特征。
items.summary_zh: 昼夜节律钟通过协调多个分子层面对钟控基因表达的调控来编排每日生理过程。然而，对这种多层节律调控的系统表征仍具挑战性，因为相关信息分散在独立数据集中，且节律性使用多样化的分析方法评估。在此，我们开发了CircaVal，一个以基因为中心的多组学平台，用于整合探索和解读人类、小鼠和狒狒的昼夜节律调控特征。为支持该框架，CircaVal使用标准化的、数据类型特定的流程处理公共数据集，并将基因节律性与组织特异性表达、跨物种同源性、功能注释和多组学调控特征整合。CircaVal进一步引入整合节律性评分（IRS），结合多种节律检测方法的一致性和独立数据集间的可重复性，为优先筛选候选节律基因提供定量基础。该平台使用户能够跨数据集检查基因节律性、识别组织富集节律基因、比较跨物种节律性并探索相关调控特征。其他功能包括交互式以基因为中心的探索、基因组浏览器可视化、用户上传时间序列数据的节律性分析以及程序化数据访

extra.description: The circadian clock orchestrates daily physiological processes through coordinated regulation of clock-controlled gene expression across multiple molecular layers. However, systematic characterization of this multilayered rhythmic regulation remains challenging because relevant information is distributed across independent datasets and rhythmicity is evaluated using diverse analytical approaches. Here, we developed CircaVal, a gene-centric multi-omics platform for the integrated exploration and interpretation of circadian regulatory features in humans, mice, and baboons. To support this framework, CircaVal processes public datasets using standardized, data-type-specific pipelines, and gene rhythmicity is integrated with tissue-specific expression, cross-species orthology, functional annotations, and multi-omics regulatory features. CircaVal further introduces an integrated rhythmicity score (IRS), which combines concordance across multiple rhythm-detection methods with reproducibility across independent datasets to provide a quantitative basis for prioritizing candidate rhythmic genes. The platform enables users to examine gene rhythmicity across datasets, identify tissue-enriched rhythmic genes, compare rhythmicity across species, and explore associated regulatory features. Additional functions include interactive gene-centric exploration, genome-browser visualization, rhythmicity analysis of user-uploaded time-series data, and programmatic data access. Together, these capabilities provide an integrated framework for rhythmic gene prioritization and gene-level interpretation of circadian regulatory features across tissues, species, datasets, and omics data types. CircaVal is freely available at https://CircaVal.com.

items.title: RNAactDrug 2.0: an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets
items.title_zh: RNAactDrug 2.0：一个更新的资源，用于系统探索跨多组学数据集中与药物敏感性相关的分子特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要 RNAactDrug 2.0（可在https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug或https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug获取）是一个更新的资源，用于系统探索跨多组学数据集中与药物敏感性相关的分子特征。我们更新了RNAactDrug 2.0数据库，显著扩展了数据并改进了功能，包括：(i) 来自大规模药物基因组学数据库的约30 000种药物、38 908个RNA分子和22 800 375个药物–RNA关联，涵盖四个分子层：表达、拷贝数变异（CNV）、突变和甲基化；(ii) 整合了来自The Cancer Genome Atlas的33种癌症类型的11 099个病例，以支持药物敏感性相关RNA特征的临床和泛癌分析；(iii) 来自>200个单细胞RNA测序数据集的约380万个细胞，涵盖34种癌症类

extra.description: Abstract RNAactDrug 2.0 (available at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug or https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug) is an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets. We have updated the RNAactDrug 2.0 database with significantly expanded data and improved features, including (i) ∼30 000 drugs, 38 908 RNA molecules, and 22 800 375 drug–RNA associations from large-scale pharmacogenomic databases, covering four molecular layers: expression, copy number variation (CNV), mutation, and methylation; (ii) 11 099 cases from The Cancer Genome Atlas across 33 cancer types are integrated to support clinical and pan-cancer analyses of drug sensitivity-associated RNA features; (iii) ∼3.8 million cells from >200 single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, spanning 34 cancer types and 38 tissues, enable analysis of cell type-specific patterns and intratumoral heterogeneity; (iv) 26 440 enhancers and 788 444 drug-enhancer associations, combined with potential target prediction, provide an exploratory epigenetic regulatory dimension; (v) enhanced search and browsing functionalities, together with seven tools for functional annotation, pan-cancer analysis, tumor microenvironment profiling, single-cell trajectory and CNV analysis, and enhancer-related analyses. In summary, RNAactDrug 2.0 is a crucial resource for the multi-omics dissection of drug sensitivity-associated molecules, providing important support for the discovery of drug resistance biomarkers and the advancement of personalized therapeutic strategies.

items.title: SpatioCAD: Context-aware graph diffusion model for pinpointing spatially variable genes in heterogeneous tissues
items.title_zh: SpatioCAD：用于在异质组织中精确定位空间变异基因的上下文感知图扩散模型
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学能够全面表征组织结构，识别空间变异基因（SVG）是定义区域特异性分子标记和揭示多样生物背景下空间调控机制的关键步骤。然而，大多数现有SVG检测方法忽视了细胞密度变化，这是肿瘤等复杂组织中的主要混杂因素，异质性细胞密度常导致假阳性。在此我们提出SpatioCAD，一个明确将真实空间表达模式与细胞密度驱动的混杂效应解耦的计算框架。SpatioCAD引入图扩散模型，内在纳入细胞密度感知条件以模拟表达传播，支持在广泛表达水平范围内识别SVG。在模拟数据集上的系统评估表明其具有优越的统计功效和特异性。应用于乳腺癌、肺癌和胶质瘤数据集，SpatioCAD识别出功能多样的SVG，包括在肿瘤进展中已确立作用的低丰度转录本，同时重现了具有生物学意义的组织结构特征。重要的是，SpatioCAD速度快且可扩展至大型组织。

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics enables comprehensive characterization of tissue architecture, and the identification of spatially variable genes (SVGs) is a critical step for defining region-specific molecular markers and uncovering spatially regulated mechanisms across diverse biological contexts. However, most existing methods for SVG detection overlook cell density variations, a major confounding factor in complex tissues such as tumors, where heterogeneous cellularity frequently introduces false-positive calls. Here we present SpatioCAD, a computational framework that explicitly decouples genuine spatial expression patterns from confounding effects driven by cellularity. SpatioCAD introduces a graph diffusion model that inherently incorporates cell-density-aware conditions to simulate expression propagation, supporting the identification of SVGs across a broad range of expression levels. Systematic evaluations on simulated datasets demonstrate its superior statistical power and specificity. Applied to breast cancer, lung cancer, and glioma datasets, SpatioCAD identifies functionally diverse SVGs, including low‑abundance transcripts with established roles in tumor progression, while also recapitulates biologically meaningful tissue architecture features. Importantly, SpatioCAD is fast and scalable to large tissues.

items.title: Diversity analysis of actinomycetes from the gut of Pheretima aspergillum and bioactive secondary metabolites from an anti-Enterococcus faecalis strain
items.title_zh: 参环毛蚓肠道放线菌多样性分析及一株抗粪肠球菌菌株的生物活性次级代谢产物
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 抗菌素耐药性是全球最紧迫的公共卫生挑战之一，耐万古霉素肠球菌（VRE）被世界卫生组织列为高优先级病原体。动物肠道环境因与宿主长期共同进化而 harbors 具有独特生物合成潜力的放线菌。参环毛蚓是一种用于中药的药用蚯蚓，持续摄入复杂有机底物，产生选择压力可能驱动其肠道共生体中新次级代谢途径的进化。然而，参环毛蚓肠道放线菌的多样性、可培养资源和抗VRE潜力仍 largely 未探索。结果 本研究首次系统表征了参环毛蚓肠道放线菌多样性。高通量16S核糖体RNA（16S rRNA）扩增子测序揭示参环毛蚓肠道细菌群落高度多样，包含21门、75纲、141目、263科、501属和608个推定物种。放线菌门排名第三优势门（相对丰度10.2%）。使用八种培养基共回收414株可培养肠道相关细菌分离株，其中332株（80.2%）为放线菌；414株中26株（6.3%）被鉴定为推定新物种。菌株CB1-

extra.description: Abstract Background Antimicrobial resistance is one of the most pressing global public health challenges, with vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus (VRE) listed as a high-priority pathogen by the World Health Organization. Animal gut environments harbor actinomycetes with unique biosynthetic potential due to long-term coevolution with hosts. Pheretima aspergillum , a medicinal earthworm used in traditional Chinese medicine, continuously ingests complex organic substrates, creating selective pressures that may drive the evolution of novel secondary metabolic pathways in its gut symbionts. However, the diversity, culturable resources, and anti-VRE potential of gut actinomycetes from P. aspergillum remain largely unexplored. Results This study presents the first systematic characterization of the gut actinomycete diversity of P. aspergillum . High-throughput 16 S ribosomal RNA (16 S rRNA) amplicon sequencing revealed that the gut bacterial community of P. aspergillum is highly diverse, comprising 21 phyla, 75 classes, 141 orders, 263 families, 501 genera, and 608 putative species. Actinomycetota ranked as the third most dominant phylum (10.2% relative abundance). A total of 414 culturable gut-associated bacterial isolates were recovered using eight culture media, of which 332 (80.2%) were actinomycetes; 26 of the 414 isolates (6.3%) were identified as putative novel species. Strain CB1-10-1, identified as Streptomyces chartreusis , exhibited broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity against vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecalis (VREfa) and other pathogens. Whole-genome sequencing and genome mining identified 38 biosynthetic gene clusters (BGC). One type II polyketide synthase cluster showed a high-confidence match to the characterized benastatin BGC (BGC0000204.5). Integrated metabolomic analysis further confirmed the production of benastatin analogues. Guided by this multi-omics strategy, benastatin B and benastatin C were isolated and structurally identified, representing the first report of benastatin production by S. chartreusis . Moreover, this study is the first to demonstrate that benastatin B exhibits potent anti-VREfa activity, with a minimum inhibitory concentration of 2 µg/mL and a minimum bactericidal concentration of 4 µg/mL – both superior to vancomycin – and it shows bactericidal properties. Conclusions This study establishes P. aspergillum as a productive source of actinomycete diversity harboring potential novel species. The multi-omics-guided discovery approach led to the identification of benastatin B as a promising bactericidal lead compound against VREfa infections, providing proof-of-concept for the value of animal symbiotic actinomycetes in antimicrobial drug discovery and a foundation for future mechanistic and preclinical studies.

items.title: AnnelidaDB: a comprehensive platform of taxonomic and multi-omic resources across annelids
items.title_zh: AnnelidaDB：一个跨环节动物的分类学和多组学资源综合平台
items.summary_zh: 摘要 环节动物栖息于海洋、淡水和陆地生态系统，是研究动物进化、再生和宿主-微生物相互作用的重要模型，然而其快速增长的组学资源仍分散在存储库和出版物中。我们开发了AnnelidaDB（www.annelidadb.com），一个基于更新系统发育框架的以物种为中心的数据库，整合了环节动物的基因组、线粒体基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、表观基因组、单细胞数据集、宿主相关共生体基因组和比较共线性。当前版本覆盖1121个物种，包括152个有核基因组的物种、177个有线粒体基因组的物种、591个有转录组数据的物种、5个有单细胞数据集（包含209,802个细胞）的物种，以及30个细菌共生体基因组。AnnelidaDB通过10个导航目录组织这些资源，并连接物种、基因组、基因、功能注释和基因家族记录。用户可以浏览基因组组装、探索交互式单细胞图谱和12,200个预计算Oxford图、运行BLAST查询并在环节动物特

extra.description: Abstract Annelids inhabit marine, freshwater, and terrestrial ecosystems and are important models for studying animal evolution, regeneration, and host–microbe interactions, yet their rapidly growing omics resources remain dispersed across repositories and publications. We developed AnnelidaDB (www.annelidadb.com), a species-centred database built on an updated phylogenetic framework that integrates genomes, mitochondrial genomes, transcriptomes, proteomes, epigenomes, single-cell datasets, host-associated symbiont genomes, and comparative synteny for Annelida. The current release covers 1121 species, including 152 species with nuclear genomes, 177 with mitochondrial genomes, 591 with transcriptome data, 5 with single-cell datasets comprising 209 802 cells, and 30 bacterial symbiont genomes. AnnelidaDB organizes these resources through 10 navigation directories and connects species, genome, gene, functional annotation, and gene-family records. Users can browse genomic assemblies, explore interactive single-cell atlases and 12 200 precomputed Oxford plots, run BLAST queries and search genes against the annelid-specific database, and submit chromosome-level data for syntenic analysis against 20 Annelida linkage groups. Sequences, annotations, and private results are available for download. As a comprehensive multi-omics resource dedicated to annelids, AnnelidaDB provides an accessible platform for comparative investigations of annelid genome evolution, adaptation, regeneration, and symbiosis.

items.title: DiseaseCIO: a multi-omics atlas for characterizing clinical intervention outcomes across diverse diseases
items.title_zh: DiseaseCIO：一个用于表征多种疾病临床干预结局的多组学图谱
items.summary_zh: 摘要：患者间临床干预结局的异质性是精准医学的主要障碍。多维高通量组学的整合有助于揭示临床干预差异的分子基础，并为结局预测、预后分层、调控模式和耐药机制提供见解。我们推出DiseaseCIO（疾病临床干预结局，http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/），一个将微生物组、转录组和表观基因组数据与人类疾病干预结局整合的数据库。它旨在在个体患者水平表征与疾病干预结局相关的分子景观。DiseaseCIO涵盖来自94种疾病状态的42,798份治疗前样本，覆盖涉及377种药理学和非药理学干预的510种治疗方案。这些样本包括从八个采样位置收集的四种标本类型。使用定制的iMOD多组学数据处理工作流，我们生成了20类分子特征，并识别出超过184万个候选特征-结局关联。DiseaseCIO还提供交互式工具，用于差异分析、预后评估、跨组学相关分析、多维特征的跨队列整合分析，以及用户提交特征集的

extra.description: Abstract Heterogeneity in clinical intervention outcomes across patients is a major barrier to precision medicine. The integration of multidimensional high-throughput omics can help reveal the molecular basis of differences in clinical interventions and provide insights into outcome prediction, prognostic stratification, regulatory patterns, and resistance mechanisms. We present DiseaseCIO (Disease Clinical Intervention Outcomes, http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/), a database that integrates microbiome, transcriptome, and epigenome data with human disease intervention outcomes. It is designed to characterize the molecular landscape associated with disease intervention outcomes at the individual patient level. DiseaseCIO encompasses 42 798 pretreatment samples from 94 disease states, covering 510 treatment regimens involving 377 pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. These samples comprise four types of specimens collected from eight sampling locations. Using the customized iMOD workflow for multi-omics data processing, we generated 20 categories of molecular features and identified >1.84 million candidate feature–outcome associations. DiseaseCIO also provides interactive tools for differential analysis, prognostic evaluation, cross-omics correlation analysis, and cross-cohort integrative analysis of multidimensional features as well as enrichment analysis and signature construction for user-submitted feature sets. DiseaseCIO provides a molecular-level resource for exploring intervention outcome heterogeneity across diseases and identifying candidate multi-omics biomarkers associated with treatment response and prognosis.

items.title: XYcellAtlas: a cell-type- and spatial-resolved pan-cancer atlas of sex-biased and Y chromosome loss-associated molecular signatures
items.title_zh: XYcellAtlas：一个细胞类型和空间分辨的泛癌图谱，涵盖性别偏倚和Y染色体丢失相关分子特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要：性别是癌症易感性、临床预后和治疗反应的关键决定因素。性染色体异常，特别是男性恶性肿瘤中Y染色体体细胞丢失（LOY），对转录调控、肿瘤免疫微环境重塑和恶性进展产生深远影响，凸显了全面整合单细胞和空间组学图谱以解析人类癌症中性别偏倚和LOY景观的迫切需求。在此，我们开发了XYcellAtlas（http://www.xycellatlas.top/），一个整合数据库，用于在单细胞转录组、表观基因组和空间转录组分辨率下整合和多维可视化人类组织中的性别差异和LOY特征。该资源汇集了来自6764份患者样本的数据，覆盖18种癌症类型、8种癌前病变和21种组织来源，包含超过2580万个单细胞和100万个空间转录组点。利用在正常组织数据集上训练的随机森林分类器，XYcellAtlas量化了跨细胞类型的细胞类型特异性LOY频率。此外，它系统编录了性别偏倚和LOY相关分子改变，包括差异表达基因、染色质峰

extra.description: Abstract Sex is a critical determinant of cancer susceptibility, clinical prognosis, and therapeutic response. Sex chromosome aberrations, particularly somatic loss of the Y chromosome (LOY) in male malignancies, exert profound impacts on transcriptional regulation, tumor immune microenvironment remodeling, and malignant progression, highlighting an urgent demand for comprehensive integration of single–cell and spatial omics profiles dissecting sex-biased and LOY landscapes across human cancers. Here, we developed XYcellAtlas (http://www.xycellatlas.top/), an integrative database for integration and multidimensional visualization of sex disparities and LOY features across human tissues at single-cell transcriptomic, epigenomic, and spatial-transcriptomic resolutions. This resource aggregates data from 6764 patient samples covering 18 cancer types, eight precancerous lesions, and 21 tissue origins, encompassing over 25.8 million single cells and one million spatial-transcriptomic spots. Leveraging random forest classifiers trained on normal tissue datasets, XYcellAtlas quantifies cell-type-specific LOY frequencies across cell types. Furthermore, it systematically catalogs sex-biased and LOY-associated molecular alterations, including differentially expressed genes, chromatin peaks, core transcription factors, as well as their functional annotations and dysregulatory signatures within malignant cells and the tumor microenvironment. In summary, XYcellAtlas provides a unified, all-in-one analytical platform enabling researchers to query, inspect, quantify, and visualize sex-associated and LOY-derived multi-omics features underlying tumor evolutionary processes.

items.title: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

items.title: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.title_zh: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.summary_zh: 战术对抗仿真实验是作战分析、模拟训练和基于仿真的装备活动的核心手段,其智能化、自动化水平直接影响实验效能和战斗力的生成。针对传统仿真实验存在的实验设计、模型构建、导调控制和人机交互效率低等问题,参考MCP协议提出大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的体系架构。该架构包含基础层、工具资源层、AI Agent层、赋能层、应用层,这5层架构自顶向下牵引,自底向上逐层整合,可实现大小模型与数据资源和传统小模型的耦合聚合,并赋能基于仿真的各项军事活动。在此基础上,重点研究讨论了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的具体路径:大模型赋能仿真实验设计,大模型赋能决策模型构建,大模型赋能导调控制。最后,分析了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验面临的挑战,并给出了相应的应对措施。

items.title: 基于多模态大模型辅助视频动作生成的预训练世界模型
items.title_zh: 基于多模态大模型辅助视频动作生成的预训练世界模型
