extra.description: 预训练世界模型是提升强化学习样本效率的关键技术,但现有方法因视频数据缺乏显式动作标注,难以捕捉状态转移的因果机制。对此,提出多模态大模型辅助的视频动作生成预训练框架(MLM-generated Action-based Pre-training from videos for world models,MAPO),通过整合视觉语言模型的语义理解能力与动力学建模需求,突破传统预训练范式在动作语义缺失方面的局限性。具体地,MAPO在预训练阶段利用多模态大模型(QWEN2_5-VL-7B)解析视频帧序列,生成细粒度语义动作描述,构建具有因果解释性的动作-状态关联;设计上下文量化编码机制,解耦场景静态特征与动态控制因素,增强跨模态表征能力。在微调阶段,通过双网络协同架构实现预训练动力学特征与真实环境动作的端到端对齐。实验表明,MAPO在DeepMind Control Suite和Meta-World的8项任务中的平均回报较最优基线获得稳定提升,尤其在长时程任务中展现出卓越的性能。该研究为跨模态世界模型训练提供了新范式,揭示了语义动作生成在因果推理中的关键作用。

items.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
items.title_zh: 基于归因的单细胞基础模型诊断
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA基础模型（scFM）越来越多地用于计算机生物发现，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示其决策依赖的是具有生物学意义的信号还是模型特定的捷径。我们系统研究了两个任务中下游预测的事后归因：使用预训练Cell2Sentence和scGPT模型进行细胞类型注释，以及在受控设置中使用scGPT+STATE进行扰动预测。对于细胞注释，我们使用归因评估预测是否依赖已确立的标记基因，以及它们的相关性如何随模型架构、表达排名和周围细胞上下文变化。对于扰动预测，我们在合成设置中将归因模式与已知调控真值比较，以评估它们对模型学习计算的揭示。在这些任务中，归因揭示了生物特征使用、上下文交互、不同输入通路的贡献、学习进展、与预测质量的关联，以及标准性能指标未完全捕捉的潜在陷阱。使用完整和有限调控知识的实验进一步表明，从归因得出的结论强烈依赖于生物参考、基线和零模型的选择。总之，这些发现凸显了归因作为灵活事后诊断的价值

extra.description: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: Comparative Strategies for Handling Imbalanced QSAR Regression: A Case Study on hERG Activity Prediction
items.title_zh: 处理不平衡QSAR回归的比较策略：hERG活性预测案例研究
items.summary_zh: 数据不平衡在QSAR建模中经常出现，但大多数研究集中于分类任务，很少涉及回归任务，因为确定数据的稀疏或密集区域具有挑战性。数据级和算法级的不平衡处理策略可能对模型性能产生不同影响。在本研究中，我们系统比较了GCN和基于指纹的机器学习模型中的各种策略。为更有意义地评估模型性能，我们基于领域知识和数据分布将目标区域划分为若干子区域。我们重点关注最具实际意义的区域。结果表明，基于该关注区域指标选择模型比使用总区域指标能带来更可靠的性能。我们还观察到，不同不平衡处理策略的效果因模型类型而异。这些发现凸显了回归QSAR建模中区域感知评估的重要性，并为不平衡数据集选择适当策略提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Data imbalance frequently occurs in QSAR modeling, yet most studies focus on classification tasks, and few address regression tasks, as it is challenging to determine which regions of the data are sparse or dense. Data-level and algorithm-level imbalance-handling strategies can have different effects on model performance. In this study, we systematically compare various strategies across GCN and fingerprint-based machine learning models. To evaluate model performance more meaningfully, we partitioned the target region into several subregions based on both domain knowledge and data distribution. We focused on the region of greatest practical interest. Our results demonstrate that selecting models based on this interest-region metric leads to more reliable performance than using the total region metric. We also observed that different imbalance-handling strategies can have divergent effects depending on the model type. These findings highlight the importance of region-aware evaluation in regression QSAR modeling and provide practical guidance for selecting appropriate strategies for imbalanced datasets.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: GraphTFactor: A graph-based approach for proteins transcription factor prediction
items.title_zh: GraphTFactor：一种基于图的蛋白质转录因子预测方法
items.summary_zh: 转录因子（TF）在调控基因表达中发挥重要作用，使其识别成为计算生物学的基本任务。在这项工作中，我们提出GraphTFactor，一种新颖的端到端框架，将蛋白质序列建模为图并直接分类转录因子。通过将序列编码为图结构，所提方法自然处理可变长度输入，同时保留相关关系信息，而不施加长度约束。实验结果表明，GraphTFactor在基准数据集上优于最先进方法，展示了基于图的表示用于TF预测的有效性，同时提供对模型预测贡献序列区域的可解释见解。为支持可重复性和实际采用，我们发布了一个开源软件包和一个交互式网络应用，使用户能够轻松对自定义序列进行TF预测。

extra.description: Transcription factors (TFs) play an important role in regulating gene expression, making their identification a fundamental task in computational biology. In this work, we propose GraphTFactor, a novel end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs and directly classifies transcription factors. By encoding sequences into graph structures, the proposed approach naturally handles variable-length inputs while preserving relevant relational information, without imposing length constraints. Experimental results show that GraphTFactor outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based representations for TF prediction while providing interpretable insights into the sequence regions contributing to the model's predictions. To support reproducibility and practical adoption, we release an open-source software package and an interactive web application that let users easily perform TF prediction on custom sequences.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Coupling cellular trajectories and RNA kinetics on continuous expression manifolds with ManifoldVelo
items.title_zh: 在连续表达流形上耦合细胞轨迹与RNA动力学：ManifoldVelo
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞转录组中联合恢复伪时间和RNA速率，需要协调全局轨迹结构与局部表达变化，尤其是在复杂周期和分支分化中。在此我们介绍ManifoldVelo，一个拓扑条件框架，联合学习细胞坐标、连续RNA轨迹和调控动力学。未剪接和剪接RNA轨迹的导数与转录-剪接-降解动力学相匹配，包括在观测细胞之间，使表达重建、细胞排序和动力学估计相互 informing。ManifoldVelo在所有评估的单细胞轨迹类型中恢复伪时间，包括循环、多分支和光滑非分支轨迹。ManifoldVelo在多峰循环模拟中在所比较方法中实现最佳伪时间恢复，并在多峰循环和分支模拟中实现剪接RNA速率最高方向一致性。真实数据分析支持跨实验板的相位预测，以及与胰腺发育阶段和标记表达一致的分化轨迹。其核心优势在于在可复用的动态参考中联合恢复不同轨迹结构中的时间位置和局部动力学。新细胞仅从剪接RNA即可获得伪时间和速率预测，无需重新拟

extra.description: Jointly recovering pseudotime and RNA velocity from static single-cell transcriptomes requires reconciling global trajectory structure with local expression changes, particularly in complex cycles and branching differentiation. Here we introduce ManifoldVelo, a topology-conditioned framework that jointly learns cellular coordinates, continuous RNA trajectories and regulatory kinetics. Derivatives of unspliced and spliced RNA trajectories are matched to transcription-splicing-degradation dynamics, including between observed cells, allowing expression reconstruction, cellular ordering and kinetic estimation to inform one another. ManifoldVelo recovers pseudotime across all evaluated single-cell trajectory types, including cyclic, multibranch and smooth non-branching trajectories. ManifoldVelo achieves the best pseudotime recovery among compared methods in multipeak cyclic simulations and the highest directional agreement for spliced RNA velocity in both multipeak cyclic and branching simulations. Real-data analyses support phase prediction across experimental plates and differentiation trajectories consistent with pancreatic developmental stages and marker expression. Its central advantage is the joint recovery of temporal position and local dynamics across distinct trajectory structures within a reusable dynamic reference. New cells are assigned pseudotime and velocity predictions from spliced RNA alone, without refitting the reference model. ManifoldVelo provides a foundation for dynamic cell atlases that transfer learned temporal and kinetic information to new samples.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
items.title_zh: 从自主智能体到认知共生体：迈向AI增强的人类智能
items.summary_zh: 十年来，人工智能的进展一直以机器能独立完成多少来衡量。大型基础模型现在能编写代码并运行多步任务，个人智能体代表个人行事。然而人们仍然会忘记曾经知道的东西，错过他们没有在看的事物，找不到合适的词语，并在没有自身历史助益的情况下面对艰难选择，因为本可提供帮助的机器置身于情境之外。随着AI进入物理世界，注意力集中在一种智能个体上，即具身机器人；我们认为物理AI时代还拥有第二种同等重要的类型，即由AI增强的人。与人工通用智能——它问机器能有多智能——并列的是AI增强人类智能（AHI），它问机器能在特定人身上使能多少智能。实现它需要一种新型系统，即认知共生体：一个终身的、嵌入式的、实时的、私密的、低摩擦的、主动的伴侣，通过外部设备感知人所感知的，跨年保持其上下文，建模其情境和心智，在正确时刻参与其思考，结合其上下文执行日常任务，并在双方变化中持续学习这个人。我们为该范式给出概念核心，即一个人能带入情

extra.description: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. As AI moves into the physical world, attention has settled on one kind of intelligent individual, the embodied robot; we argue that the era of Physical AI holds a second kind of equal importance, the person augmented by AI. Alongside artificial general intelligence, which asks how intelligent a machine can be, stands AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI), which asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person. Realizing it calls for a new kind of system, a cognitive symbiont: a lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive companion that senses what the person senses through external devices, keeps their context across years, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out everyday tasks with their context, and keeps learning the person as both change. We give the paradigm a conceptual core, the cognitive gap between what a person could bring to a situation and what they can hold in working memory, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop of sensing, keeping, understanding, living alongside, acting for and thinking with the person, and growing, enclosed by a personal runtime and by trust. Because a symbiont changes what a person can do in front of others, it also raises risks of a new kind, from covert assistance in examinations to pressure on everyone to adopt it, and we treat their governance as part of the paradigm.

items.title: A Bayesian Optimized Biquad Filter-Burg Model for Real-Time EEG Phase Estimation
items.title_zh: 一种用于实时EEG相位估计的贝叶斯优化双二阶滤波器-Burg模型
items.summary_zh: 对刺激对齐的瞬态EEG进行实时相位估计对于靶向theta频段的闭环神经调控系统至关重要，然而大多数实时相位估计方法是在alpha频段的静息态高保真信号上开发和验证的。近期工作追求深度学习架构，而个体化经典带通滤波器调谐仍未被充分探索。本研究表征非预期带通滤波的频谱和时间特性，并展示通过个体化调谐实现的性能增益。我们提出贝叶斯优化双二阶滤波器-Burg（BOB）模型，在左正中神经外周振动触觉刺激期间记录的EEG（theta，N=20健康受试者）以及Max Planck研究所LEMON数据集的静息态记录（alpha，N=20健康受试者）上评估。BOB在匹配测试条件下与深度双分支复数神经网络（DBCNN）、EEG相位预测网络（EPN）、Phastimate和自回归填充相位估计（PEAP）进行基准比较：通道选择、个体化优化、评估时间点，以及通过零相位滤波和Hilbert变换获得的离线参考相位。在这

extra.description: Real-time phase estimation on stimulus-aligned transient EEG is critical for closed-loop neuromodulation systems targeting the theta-band, yet most real-time phase estimation methods have been developed and validated on resting-state, high-fidelity signals in the alpha band. Recent work has pursued deep learning architectures, while individualized classical bandpass filter tuning remains underexplored. This study characterizes the spectral and temporal properties of non-anticipative bandpass filtering and demonstrates the performance gains achieved through individualized tuning. We present a Bayesian-Optimized Biquad Filter-Burg (BOB) model evaluated on EEG recorded during peripheral vibrotactile stimulation of the left median nerve (theta, N=20 healthy subjects) and on resting-state recordings from the Max Planck Institute's LEMON dataset (alpha, N=20 healthy subjects). BOB was benchmarked against the Deep Dual-Branch Complex Neural Network (DBCNN), EEG Phase Prediction Network (EPN), Phastimate, and Phase Estimation with Autoregressive Padding (PEAP) under matched testing conditions: channel selection, individualized optimization, evaluation time points, and an offline reference phase obtained through zero-phase filtering and the Hilbert transform. Under these testing conditions, BOB achieved matched or better performance than these models at a fraction of the calibration time.

items.title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
items.title_zh: 阅读为什么：在光和量子比特上具有精确词证据的玻恩测量注意力
items.summary_zh: 当语言模型回答时，我们通常只能估计为什么。我们构建一个Transformer，其中每一步都是玻恩测量——注意力$|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$按行归一化，用测量乘积替代前馈非线性，以及玻恩读出。其分母保持在输入值上时，每个类别概率是词振幅的多项式，因此其积分梯度证据通过有限求积计算且无求积误差：词的贡献在高于其无信息份额之上求和至类别概率，精度达$10^{-11}$或更好。在e-SNLI自然语言推理上，嵌入之外约98k参数，模型达到$76.98 \pm 0.17$%测试准确率，与同等大小softmax Transformer（$76.62 \pm 0.36$%）持平。删除其证据排名第一的词在45%的测试对中改变答案，而在任何单次删除可改变的53%中，相比之下softmax模型以同样方式解释为32%，其注意力×梯度为40%。注意力可以看起来更像标注者高亮的词，但对答案的解释更

extra.description: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look more like the words annotators highlighted, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibm_kingston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers on two short test pairs and kept or changed them under deletion as the model does; the evidence itself did not yet survive the device, and we work out the shots and calibration that measuring it on hardware would need.

items.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 对抗性推测推理改善长时程智能体
items.summary_zh: 推测解码一直被纯粹视为一种系统优化，可加速大语言模型解码而不改变模型行为。在这种观点下，训练更好草稿模型的日益增长的努力仅集中在接受率上。我们认为这种观点对长时程智能体推理并不成立。在复杂智能体任务上用不同推测解码方法测量前沿开放权重模型，我们发现数值噪声在验证窗口内增长，思考过程的草稿接受结果可在30步后改变模型的输出分布，从而以随机方向显著影响长时程智能体的推理准确率。在这项工作中，我们通过控制此类噪声来提高目标模型的推理能力。虽然我们无法改变目标模型验证的总体token分布，但我们可以通过训练草稿模型被拒绝来以最高精度编码关键推理。我们在智能体轨迹中识别这些点，并训练草稿模型偏好对抗性偏好。在推理时，训练后的草稿和目标恰好在这些决策点分道扬镳，验证重新开始，使关键思考token从目标模型采样并在其最无噪声条件下编码。这种方法使关键推理在长时程中更好地被索引且更持久。在复杂智能体编码基

extra.description: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

items.title: A Circuit for In-Context Learning
items.title_zh: 上下文学习的电路
items.summary_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）让预训练语言模型执行由其提示中演示指定的任务，无需参数更新。在任意标签下，模型必须获得它不可能记住的映射，因此学习发生在单次前向传播内。先前工作找到了候选部分，但未找到它们如何组合。我们给出三个3-4B参数Transformer中任意标签少样本句子分类的组合。模型在标签token位置上实现键值记忆：每个标签token的残差流编码标签身份，中层注意力头将前一个演示的类别作为其键写入其中。在查询处，上层头将查询类别与存储的键匹配并复制出匹配标签。一个编码是否有任何标签重复的早期层信号门控此读出；在其缺失时，读取器关注提示开头，没有标签被偏好。一组单独的头抑制最近看到的标签。每一步通过激活修补、针对随机头基线的头消融以及用模型自身信号进行引导来因果确立。读出的softmax模型，每个头两个常数，在一个提示分布上拟合，预测另一个。该计算在三个模型中保守，仅命名的头即可重现行为，

extra.description: In-context learning (ICL) lets a pretrained language model perform a task specified by demonstrations in its prompt, with no parameter updates. With arbitrary labels the model must acquire a mapping it cannot have memorized, so the learning happens within a single forward pass. Prior work found candidate parts but not how they compose. We give the composition for few-shot sentence classification with arbitrary labels in three 3-4B-parameter transformers. The model implements a key-value memory over label-token positions: each label token's residual stream encodes the label's identity, and middle-layer attention heads write into it the class of the preceding demonstration as its key. At the query, upper-layer heads match the query's class against the stored keys and copy out the matching labels. An early-layer signal encoding whether any label has repeated gates this readout; in its absence the readers attend to the start of the prompt and no label is favored. A separate set of heads suppresses the most recently seen label. Each step is established causally by activation patching, head ablations against random-head baselines, and steering with the model's own signals. A softmax model of the readout with two constants per head, fit on one prompt distribution, predicts another. The computation is conserved across the three models, the named heads alone reproduce the behaviour, and a transformer trained from scratch grows the same parts. The circuit transfers to semantic concepts and to labels with meaning, and the same parts, with a causal gate, appear from 0.6B to 8B in one family and survive instruction tuning. ICL in this setting is a gated associative lookup built from a few identifiable component types, traced causally from demonstrations to prediction.

items.title: MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection
items.title_zh: MedPhysBench：评估语言模型在医学物理计算和错误检测上的基准
items.summary_zh: 医学物理学家将处方转化为递送剂量并互相检查计算，因为束流校准或监测单元（MU）计算中的一个错误可影响用其治疗的每位患者。MedPhysBench有十个种子生成器，生成放射治疗、诊断成像、核医学和辐射防护中的计算项目，直至TG-51校准工作表等临床任务。参考答​​案来自实施 governing protocols 的代码，评分器转换单位并应用容差带。从相同输入，单独的检查项目测试错误检测，展示同事的工作表或仅同事的结果，一半正确，一半植入一个错误。在1,200个项目的留出测试分割上（一半用于两个模型），12个模型在计算上得分33.3%至100.0%。在四个最佳模型（99.3-100.0%）被评分为不正确的九个答案中，五个包含模型错误，四个遵循NCRP报告151，而我们的项目在点上陈述错误或留有余地。在它们之下，大多数模型在3级临床任务上表现最差，Claude Sonnet 5.5在20个等中

extra.description: Medical physicists turn a prescription into a delivered dose and check one another's calculations, because one error in a beam calibration or a monitor-unit (MU) calculation can affect every patient treated with it. MedPhysBench has ten seeded generators of calculation items in radiation therapy, diagnostic imaging, nuclear medicine and radiation protection, up to clinical tasks such as a TG-51 calibration worksheet. Reference answers come from code implementing the governing protocols, and a grader converts units and applies tolerance bands. From the same inputs, separate checking items test error detection, showing a colleague's worksheet or only the colleague's result, half correct and half with one planted error. On a held-out test split of 1,200 items (half for two models), 12 models scored 33.3 to 100.0% on calculation. Of the nine answers graded incorrect for the four best (99.3-100.0%), five contained model errors and four followed NCRP Report 151 on points our items misstate or leave open. Below them, most models did worst on level-3 clinical tasks, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 omitted the inverse-square correction in 19 of 20 isocentric MU items. Five models detected at least 96.7% of mostly large planted errors with at most 4% false alarms; for four of the other seven, checking only the result raised false alarms significantly. In an exploratory targeted test with 20 public cases of an omitted inverse-square correction, the three best models tested caught it in every worksheet, and three weaker models accepted 16 to 18 of 20 planted worksheets, one of them while applying the correction in most of its own calculations. Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 6 of 20 wrong results, although it applied the correction in all 20 of its own. We report the effect of two problems in our shielding items, found after the runs, and release the code, per-item outcomes and targeted-test responses.

items.title: CATF: A Manager-Worker Framework for Context-Aware Time-Series Forecasting
items.title_zh: CATF：一种用于上下文感知时间序列预测的经理-工人框架
items.summary_zh: 我们研究上下文感知时间序列预测，其中单个目标变量从其自身历史和一组上下文变量（如天气和日历信息）预测。随着上下文变得更加多样，单一模型难以捕获其所有状态，而集成学习和专家混合方法依赖手动数据分区或软路由，这增加推理成本并阻碍可解释性。我们提出CATF，一种基于经理-工人架构的上下文感知时间序列预测框架：基于Transformer的经理根据上下文将每个输入路由到单个工人，在训练和推理期间均使用硬路由。工人因此在无需手动数据分区的情况下专业化，任何单模型预测器都可作为工人。在五个上下文丰富的数据集、四个预测范围和两种归一化方案上，CATF在200次比较中的162次中优于其独立对应物，最佳CATF增强模型在20个设置中的19个中优于最佳独立基线，并在20个设置中的15个中优于零样本Time-MoE基础模型。关于共享单车数据的案例研究表明，经理按日历路由输入，每个工人专精于不同的每周模式。

extra.description: We study context-aware time-series forecasting, in which a single target variable is predicted from its own history and a set of contextual variables, such as weather and calendar information. As the context becomes more diverse, a single model struggles to capture all of its regimes, while ensemble learning and Mixture-of-Experts approaches rely on manual data partitioning or soft routing, which increases the inference cost and hinders interpretability. We propose CATF, a Context-Aware Time-Series Forecasting framework built on a Manager-Worker architecture: a Transformer-based Manager routes each input to a single Worker based on the context, using hard routing during both training and inference. The Workers thus specialize without manual data partitioning, and any single-model forecaster can serve as a Worker. On five context-rich datasets, four horizons, and two normalization schemes, CATF improves over its standalone counterpart in 162 of 200 comparisons, the best CATF-enhanced model outperforms the best standalone baseline in 19 of 20 settings, and it outperforms the zero-shot Time-MoE foundation model in 15 of 20 settings. A case study on bike-sharing data shows that the Manager routes inputs by the calendar and that each Worker specializes in a different weekly pattern.

items.title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
items.title_zh: HARP：用于基于LLM的推荐的无训练双画像智能体通信
items.summary_zh: 在基于LLM的推荐中，记忆在记忆增强骨干中充当用户级智能体。然而用户和物品仍然不对称：只有用户被给予结构化画像；它进入带宽受限的重排序器提示；并在预热后冻结。我们将基于LLM的推荐重新定义为四阶段的智能体通信过程：构建自我描述、沿协作图传输它、理解另一方、并从下一次交互同步它。这一表述揭示了三个未解决的通信挑战：物品侧从不产生可比较的自我描述（单侧构建）；画像级信号仅进入带宽受限的重排序器提示而非检索，在那里它们不会竞争上下文token（提示陷阱理解）；用户的描述在预热后冻结，没有原则性更新规则（缺失同步）。我们将缺失阶段实例化为HARP（通过双画像的同质性感知智能体推荐），一个对冻结LLM骨干的无训练、三算子添加：规则提取的对称物品画像（零额外LLM调用）、通道可分解的画像级同质性H(phi_u, phi_i)在检索时而非重排序器提示内消费，以及单遍反思更新实现上下文内画像演化而无需任何

extra.description: In LLM-based recommendation, memory acts as a user-level agent in a memory-augmented backbone. Yet users and items remain asymmetric: only the user is given a structured profile; it enters a bandwidth-limited reranker prompt; and it is frozen after warmup. We recast LLM-based recommendation as an agentic-communication process in four stages: BUILD a self-description, TRANSMIT it along the collaborative graph, UNDERSTAND the other side, and SYNC it from the next interaction. This formulation reveals three unresolved communication challenges: the item side never produces a comparable self-description (one-sided BUILD); profile-level signals enter only the bandwidth-limited reranker prompt rather than retrieval, where they would not compete for context tokens (prompt-trapped UNDERSTAND); and the user's description is frozen after warmup with no principled update rule (absent SYNC). We instantiate the missing stages as HARP (Homophily-aware Agentic Recommendation via dual Profiles), a training-free, three-operator addition to a frozen LLM backbone: a rule-extracted symmetric item profile (zero extra LLM calls), a channel-decomposable profile-level homophily H(phi_u, phi_i) consumed at retrieval time rather than inside the reranker prompt, and a single-pass reflective update realising in-context profile evolution without any gradient step. On four public benchmarks (Yelp, Books, MovieTV, Goodreads), HARP lifts Hit@1 over the strongest published baseline by 6.9%-24.0%, with family-wise Holm-corrected p < 1e-9 on every dataset. Ablations and a per-case attribution study show that the operators contribute complementary gains, with the retrieval-side gate as the main source; we also report the trade-off introduced by the reflective pass. We formulate agentic communication and provide a training-free instantiation. Code is available at https://github.com/Jove-Zhen/HARP.

items.title: DCAF: Unifying Data Validity, Evaluation Validity and Predictive Modeling for Single-cell Perturbation Simulation
items.title_zh: DCAF：统一数据有效性、评估有效性和预测建模用于单细胞扰动模拟
items.summary_zh: 单细胞扰动图谱受成本和通量限制，而计算方法仍受限于不一致的评估和相对于简单基线的表现不佳。在此我们提出DCAF，一个用于单细胞扰动模拟的统一框架，联合解决数据有效性、评估有效性和预测建模。在其三个组件中，DCAF-data通过熵正则化最优传输重建扰动前和扰动后状态来解决单次测量限制，并在细胞系和多细胞类型数据集上展示。DCAF-criterion评估非沉默基因的log倍数变化，以提高对模型错误的敏感性和对零膨胀噪声的鲁棒性，在合成数据集上验证。DCAF-model将JEPA与显式建模结合用于调控动力学建模，以实现可解释预测。在基准上，DCAF在跨基因、跨细胞类型和跨区域泛化中优于最先进深度学习方法以及均值和线性基线。在成年小鼠大脑中，DCAF在细胞类型和基因水平上重现了Dgcr8敲低已知的细胞类型特异性调控异质性。因此DCAF为跨发育、疾病和治疗发现的可靠扰动模拟提供了严谨且生物学基础的基

extra.description: Single-cell perturbation profiling is limited by cost and throughput, while computational methods remain constrained by inconsistent evaluation and underperformance relative to simple baselines. Here we present DCAF, a unified framework for single-cell perturbation simulation that that jointly addresses data validity, evaluation validity and predictive modeling. Among its three components, DCAF-data addresses the single-measurement limitation by reconstructing pre- and post-perturbation status using entropy-regularized optimal transport, and is demonstrated on both cell line and multi-cell type datasets. DCAF-criterion evaluates log fold changes in non-silenced genes to improve sensitivity to model error and robustness to zero inflation noise, validated on synthetic datasets. DCAF-model combines JEPA with explicit modeling for regulatory-dynamics modeling for interpretable prediction. Across benchmarks, DCAF outperforms state-of-the-art deep-learning methods, as well as mean and linear baselines in cross-gene, cross-cell-type and cross-region generalization. In adult Mouse brain, DCAF recapitulates known cell-type-specific regulatory heterogeneity of Dgcr8 knockdown at both cell type and gene levels. DCAF thus provides a rigorous and biologically grounded foundation for reliable perturbation simulation across development, disease and therapeutic discovery.
